input_messages.content: Hi, um, I placed an order recently, and I need to make some changes to it. Could you help me with that?
Okay, I don't quite remember my email right now. But my name is Yara Silva, and my zip code is 77159.

Thank you. I want to change my laptop order to be sent to my NYC address. I don't want to say the address here, but it should be in my orders profile. Also, I want to change the laptop to item number 9844888101. And, um, I also want to change my watch order. I want a watch with a black dial but keeping the leather strap.

Yes, I confirm those changes. The laptop is the only item I want to change in that order, and the watch is the only item I want to change in its order. And yes, please apply the address change only to the laptop order. Thank you.
No, that's all for now. Thank you for your help. I appreciate it. Have a good day. ###STOP###
